sloka: इमान्यश्वसहस्राणि चत्वारि पुरुषर्षभ ।रथानां द्वे सहस्रे च गजानां शतमुत्तमम् ।। ७.६४.२ ॥
transliteration: imānyaśvasahasrāṇi catvāri puruṣarṣabha ।rathānāṁ dve sahasre ca gajānāṁ śatamuttamam ।। 7.64.2 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, take these four thousand horses, two thousand chariots, and a hundred excellent elephants.
